description: This file defines the SugarWidgetSubPanelTopSelectUsersButton class, which extends SugarWidgetSubPanelTopSelectButton. It implements a widget button for selecting users within a subpanel in the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM interface, handling the display and JavaScript popup logic for user selection.

classes.name: SugarWidgetSubPanelTopSelectUsersButton
classes.description: A widget button class for selecting users in a subpanel, with methods to display the button and generate the associated popup action.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display label for the button.

methods.name: display
